checks.name: a. resistive divider, .op
checks.diagnostics: ngspice op on 3 element line(s); 1 data row(s); op_value of v(out)

checks.name: c. RC low-pass, .ac corner vs grid density
checks.grid_sensitivity_note: corner shifts by this much when the frequency grid is refined 10x; a corner that moved materially here would not be a trustworthy QoI
checks.dominant_error_finding: The corner's error is NOT dominated by grid density. |H_dc| is proxied by |H| at fstart, biasing the corner high by a relative (fstart/fc)^2 — 1e-4 at fstart=10Hz, confirmed to 3 digits by the fstart sweep above and by closed-form algebra (u = sqrt(1+2s^2)). That bias is ~26x LARGER than the 3.8e-6 grid delta measured at the same fstart. Reporting the grid delta as the corner's error bar would understate it by that factor.

checks.name: d. RC step, .tran convergence vs tmax
e. series RLC step overshoot (D.5 discretization screen)
checks.screen_note: max(v_out) is an EXTREMUM QoI and therefore a discretization-artifact suspect. The trend across tightening tmax is the screen: a peak that keeps climbing as the step shrinks is tracking the grid, not the physics.

checks.name: f. adversarial probes (jails proven by failing the escape)
